entities.name: tert-Butyl ester cleavage
observations: Decoded reaction replaces a tert-butyl ester, R-C(=O)-O-tBu, with carboxylic acid R-C(=O)-OH; rest of scaffold and shown stereochemistry are unchanged.
Proposed reagent class: acid-mediated tert-butyl ester deprotection, commonly TFA or HCl; specific conditions are not identifiable from structures alone.
